newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil current account data due next week.
newsitem.headline: Brazil current account data due next week.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank expects to publish balance of payments data for 1996 next week, a spokesman said.
Current account results, foreign reserve levels and foreign direct investment data are usually issued a few days after the trade balance.
But Altamir Lopes, head of the bank's economics department and the official who usually reveals the figures, is on holiday.
"We hope to issue the balance of payments on Monday but that has still to be confirmed," the Central Bank spokesman said.
